# Sample logs

**All files here are synthetic.** They are generated by `generate_samples.py` (fixed random seed)
and contain no real data. IP addresses come from reserved documentation ranges
(192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) or private ranges.

| File | What it is | What it should show |
|---|---|---|
| `normal_ssh_auth.log` | Ordinary SSH logins, sudo, cron | Nothing suspicious |
| `bruteforce_ssh_auth.log` | Normal activity + 327 failed logins from `203.0.113.50` in under 4 minutes, then one accepted login from that IP | SSH brute-force indicators |
| `normal_web_access.log` | Ordinary web traffic (Apache combined format) | Nothing suspicious |
| `suspicious_web_access.log` | Normal traffic + scanner (`198.51.100.99`), `/login` guessing (`203.0.113.77`), request flood (`192.0.2.200`) | Unusual HTTP activity |
| `sample_events.csv` / `.json` / `.jsonl` | The same generic events in three structured formats with different field names | Parser flexibility; failed logins and port probing from `203.0.113.9` |
| `malformed_sample.log` | Garbage text | A clear "unrecognized format" error |

Regenerate with: `python generate_samples.py`
